structuredContent.query: SELECT id,experiment_id,headline,primary_text,description,call_to_action,destination_url,video_url,status,agent_review_status,reviewed_at,agent_reviewed_at FROM creative WHERE experiment_id IN (91,92) ORDER BY id DESC
